Name: Start With Bigger Backpack
Author: tbonehunter
Description: Allows you to set the size of your backpack (inventory) to 12, 24 or 36 from the title screen, so you can have a bigger backpack when the game begins. This is helpful when you use Custom Starter Package and have more items than can fit in a vanilla 12 slot bundle with the tools, before you have storage chests to put them in. Click the gear icon on the title screen

Downloads.Description: Start the game with 12,24 or 36 slot backpack. Edit options from the title screen (gear icon in lower left corner.) Default is 12.

Manifest.Name: Start With Bigger Backpack
Manifest.Description: Start a new game with a larger backpack (24 or 36 slots) instead of the default 12.
